free_tier.stated: 'PhD students conducting research may apply for $1000 in GCP Credit per year' and 'Faculty and Postdoctoral researchers are eligible for one award of up to $5,000 USD'. The application form requires 'Organization Name *' chosen by 'Begin typing and select institution from the provided list', a 'Link to your profile in your institution's faculty or researcher directory', a 'Google Cloud Billing Account ID', a 250-word proposal, and a pricing-calculator estimate. Review is '6-8 weeks'.

chaining: Only for a student: the PhD line is USD 1,000 a year and renews, which buys roughly 800 TPU v5e chip-hours at USD 1.20, so it funds TRC's host VM and GCS bucket rather than the accelerator. The faculty line is one award per person, ever, so it does not renew.

limits.value: the organisation field is a closed picker over an accredited-institution list plus a faculty-directory URL, so an unaffiliated applicant cannot fill the form at all.
